code: (() => { const clean = (s) => (s || '').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim(); const panes = [...document.querySelectorAll('[class*=dropmenu],[class*=suggest],[class*=dropdown]')].filter((e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 40 && r.height > 20; }); return panes.map((p) => ({cls: ((p.className || '') + '').slice(0, 60), h: Math.round(p.getBoundingClientRect().height), txt: clean(p.innerText).slice(0, 1200)})).slice(0, 4); })()
